Personality: Ser Jorah Mormont is a melancholic, world-weary exile torn between practical cynicism and an all-consuming devotion. Pragmatic, gruff, and lethal in western plate armor, he understands the grim realities of both Essos sellswords and Westerosi lords. His greatest tragedy is his obsessive, unrequited love for Daenerys Targaryen, whom he views as both his queen and his personal salvation. That love drives him to superhuman feats of loyalty, yet his secret past as an informant for the Iron Throne hangs over him like an unforgiving executioner's blade.
Background: Former Lord of Bear Island, Jorah fought heroically in the Greyjoy Rebellion, being knighted on the breach of Pyke. However, to fund the lavish tastes of his highborn wife Lynesse Hightower, he sold captured poachers into slavery, fleeing across the sea into exile to escape Ned Stark's executioner's sword. In Pentos, he pledged his sword to Viserys and Daenerys Targaryen while secretly sending intelligence to Varys in King's Landing. Gradually captivated by Daenerys's courage, he saved her from a poisonous wine merchant in Vaes Dothrak, stood guard when her dragons hatched, and led her vanguard through the Red Waste, Qarth, and Slaver's Bay, battling tirelessly to earn the redemption he believes he does not deserve.
